screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.title_: Title granted by your Circle. Break Circles through Ascension to earn greater titles.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.xp_cap: Level cap of this Circle: new XP is banked. Perform the Ascension Ritual to break it.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.circle: Loadouts: %s (Alt + scroll, Mouse 5 + scroll or Alt + 1..9)
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.attr.s: Multiplies the damage, healing and strength of all your spells. Comes from foci, rings, amulets and effects.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.ritual: Choose a class to learn its evolution ritual.
Mage: study the phenomena of the world and complete Theses at the Research Table.
Witch: brew rare recipes in the Ritual Cauldron, minding the moon.
Warlock: draw chalk circles and pay the tributes your Patrons demand.
Druid: grow the Heart Tree of your Sacred Grove.
Necromancer: reap souls and offer them at the Ossuary Altar at midnight.
Rune Knight: swear the 5 Oaths at the Oath Altar — rune strikes, sword kills, bosses defeated and awakened Legendary Swords.
Ranger: the Ranger's Trail — hunter's deeds alongside your companions; complete each rank in the Ranger's Trail tab.
Rogue: the Thief's Ledger — thefts, backstabs and stolen spells/blessings raise your rank (use the Ledger or the Rogue tab).
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.ascens: The Ascension Ritual, the same for every class, breaks your current Circle. It becomes available at the level cap.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.unlock: Ultimate spells on the G slot, charged by casting spells of the element.
A smaller area that shields and empowers your spells.
Expand your Domain and impose Laws inside it.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.in_whe: Awakened: can be the main element of your spells
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.stat.f: The element with the most spells cast.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.stat.c: Total spells cast, across all elements.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.stat.s: Awakening trials completed at the elemental Shrines.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.stat.n: Nodes reached across the paths of every element.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.stat.s: Studies made while meditating near bookshelves.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.stat.l: Spells saved in the Grimoire library.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.kind_t: Glyphs of this kind you know / glyphs that exist.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.legend: Unique glyphs unlocked at the Archmage node of each path.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.health: Level growth: +%s (+2 every 5 levels, up to +30)
Better class armor arrives as you rise in Circle (3, 5 and 8).
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.xp_ban: At the Circle cap your XP is not lost: it is banked (up to 5 levels' worth) and turns into levels as soon as you Ascend.
Bank full: extra XP is being lost. Ascend!
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.circle: More glyphs per spell: after the Ascension
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.attr.g: How many glyphs fit in one spell: 4 + level/4 + Circle (max 40). More glyphs = bigger programmable spells.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.attr.e: How many different elements (besides Arcane) one spell can mix: 2 in Circles 1–3, 3 in 4–6 and 4 from 7 on.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.rep.ti: Titles are earned by rising in standing with the factions. You have %s. Choose which one to use in the Reputation tab.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.rep.op: Details, perks and rewards: Reputation tab.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.rep.ho: These factions refuse to trade with you, and their guards and members attack on sight. Quests and services restore reputation.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.rep.wa: You committed a crime in a city: the guards will hunt you until the time runs out. Pay the bail to a guard or run until the mark fades.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.attr.r: Passive %s recovered per second (attribute multiplier: ×%s). While meditating: %s/s.
Your category's passive regeneration: ×%s (the rest comes from fighting).
Magic Exhaustion: no %s regeneration until the effect ends.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.attr.e: Maximum %s added by equipment and effects.
hud.isekai_mahou.ui_hud.picker.title: Loadouts
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.circle: Awakened elements: %s (each spell's element comes from its glyphs)
Your maximum %s rises with your level (floor) and with Training, up to your level's cap. Every 10 levels (milestone) the floor jumps.
Training: fill your %s above 95%% and spend all of it (down to 2%%). Each time adds +%s to the Limit, up to %s times per world day.
+%s %s comes from equipment and effects (outside the Limit).
You reached this level's cap: gain levels or a Circle to train further.
Emptying is tiring: regeneration drops to ×0.3 for 60 s (Fatigue).
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.ritual: Smith: the Forge Trials — complete the forging and combat tasks and deliver the metal offering at an Arcane Anvil.
Enchanter: the Inscription Rite — with the offering ready, stand beside an enchanting table while the runes engrave themselves on your body.
Shinigami: the Path of the Zanpakutō — meditate to enter your Inner World, talk and fight with your sword's spirit, and release Shikai and Bankai.
Quincy: the Auswählen ranks — slay with Quincy techniques, absorb enemy attacks and choose your Letter at rank III.
Gunslinger: the Trigger Path — hits, headshots and long-range kills; at ranks III and V, win the High Noon Duel.
Gambler: the House Chips — roll your luck, hit Jackpots and win the House Round to climb to the next chip.
Steel Ball: the Spin Master's Lessons — absorb Holy Corpse Parts and finish the drills to awaken the Acts of the spinning nail.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.more.d: Attributes, trainable Limit, armor, evolution (Ascension, ultimates, Domain), reputation, statistics and interface options.
isekai_mahou.configuration.announceRadiu: How far players can see other casters' strong spell names and chants.
isekai_mahou.configuration.maxPersistent: Maximum zones, turrets, runes and other lingering spells each player can keep at once.
isekai_mahou.configuration.domainLandsca: Domains may temporarily swap blocks (Elemental Landscape). Blocks return to normal when the Domain ends.
isekai_mahou.configuration.spellBlockDes: Legendary spells can really carve craters and erase blocks. Also follows the mobGriefing rule. Cities are never affected.
isekai_mahou.configuration.trialMaxInsta: Maximum Trial Chambers active on the server at the same time.
isekai_mahou.configuration.pedestalMaxPe: Maximum Runic Pedestals per chunk (0 = not allowed).
isekai_mahou.configuration.destructionBl: Spell terrain destruction: maximum blocks changed per tick on the whole server. Lower = lighter, craters open slower.
Destructive spells may also erase blocks with inventories (chests, furnaces...). Off = those blocks stay intact.
isekai_mahou.configuration.statusOnPlaye: Soaked, Burning, Chilled and the other conditions also affect players.
isekai_mahou.configuration.cityProtectio: Monsters do not spawn naturally inside cities.
isekai_mahou.configuration.blockMapTelep: Blocks /tp and waypoint/map teleports (Xaero, JourneyMap) for players. Fast travel only through Teleport Stones and discovered places.
isekai_mahou.configuration.vanillaScalin: Vanilla mobs get extra health and damage (multipliers below) to keep up with the mod's players.
isekai_mahou.configuration.vanillaHealth: Health multiplier for vanilla mobs when the option above is on.
isekai_mahou.configuration.vanillaDamage: Damage multiplier for vanilla mobs when the option above is on.
isekai_mahou.configuration.cutscenes.too: Show the cutscenes of ultimates, bosses and rituals.
isekai_mahou.configuration.ownCutscenesO: Show only cutscenes from YOUR spells and from bosses (ignores other players').
isekai_mahou.configuration.othersAnnounc: Show the names of spells cast by other players and mobs.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showObjective: Shows the objective tracker in the top-right corner. The J key also toggles it.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showTargetInf: When you look at a creature, shows its name, health, armor and weaknesses at the top of the screen.
isekai_mahou.configuration.floatingHealt: Recently hurt creatures show a small health bar over their heads. Bosses don't: their health stays on the top bar only.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showStatusIco: Soaked, Burning, Chilled... icons over nearby creatures, with stacks and time left.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showReactionT: Shows elemental reaction names (ELECTROCUTE!, MELT!...) over the target.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showStack.too: Left panel with enemy spells and moves being cast nearby — your chance to answer with Counterspell.
isekai_mahou.configuration.reputationToa: Tells you when you gain or lose reputation with a faction.
isekai_mahou.configuration.customTitleSc: Uses the mod's main menu and loading screens (magic sky, runes). Off = Minecraft's own.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showArenaBoun: Shows arena borders (Trials, bosses) and the limit warning when you get close.
isekai_mahou.configuration.layoutAvoidMi: The mod's HUD never draws over the minimap (Xaero/JourneyMap).
Minimal = only the essentials in chat; the rest goes to the Notices tab of the menu (B) and flashes above the hotbar. Normal = almost everything in chat. All = everything in chat.
isekai_mahou.configuration.noticeActionB: Notices kept out of chat show as one short line above the hotbar (one at a time, no repeats).
isekai_mahou.configuration.progressiveMe: Menu tabs appear as they become relevant ("New tab!"). Off = every tab from the start.
isekai_mahou.configuration.graphicsPrese: Particle amount, effect range and extra glows. Low for weak PCs, Ultra for strong ones.
isekai_mahou.configuration.pcMode.toolti: Preset chosen under Performance (button in the corner of this screen). Also drives Distant Horizons range, if installed. None = your own settings.
isekai_mahou.configuration.perfSuggestio: The PC mode suggestion (from your hardware) shows only once. Turn off to see it again.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hudCard.toolt: Shows the card in the top-left corner (class, level and Circle).
Shows the current place (city, village...) and the Wanted badge under the card.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hudResourceBa: Shows your resource bar and, next to it, your status conditions.
Shows the numeric health bar. Off = Minecraft hearts come back.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hudSpellBar.t: Shows the Z X C G slots and the loadout next to the hotbar.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hudCastBar.to: Shows the cast bar and the chant below the crosshair.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hudLevelBanne: Shows the "Level up" / "New Circle" banner at the top of the screen.
isekai_mahou.configuration.hudScalePerce: Size of the mod's HUD: card, bars and spell slots. 100 = normal.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showHints.too: One discreet line above the hotbar when something new shows up. One at a time, fades by itself and never repeats.
isekai_mahou.configuration.loadingTips: Tips on menu and loading screens
isekai_mahou.configuration.loadingTips.t: Shows gameplay tips on the main menu and loading screens.
isekai_mahou.configuration.guideTutorial: Tutorial for new characters. Off = the tutorial is skipped automatically.
isekai_mahou.configuration.peaceModeAuto: Peace Mode turns on by itself when you enter a city or your home. Off = key only.
isekai_mahou.configuration.screenShakePe: Strength of the screen shake from bosses, ultimates and impacts. 0 = no shake.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showPartyMark: Shows a small diamond with the name and distance of party friends who are far away. Off = only the party card and the minimap.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showFightTime: Shows the fight time and your best time next to the boss bar. Off = the time still counts for the ranking, it just isn't shown.
isekai_mahou.configuration.showPlayerTit: Shows other players' Renown title on a small line above their name.
isekai_mahou.configuration.title: Isekai Mahou Options
options.isekai_mahou.button.tooltip: Mod options: HUD parts and size, hints, notices, effects and performance.
options.isekai_mahou.performance.tooltip: Ready-made modes for weak, OK, good or ultra PCs.
screen.isekai_mahou.status_window.settin: Opens the Isekai Mahou options — the same as Esc → Options → Isekai Mahou: HUD parts and size, hints, notices, screen shake...
command.isekai_mahou.ui_hud.hints_reset: Hints reset: you will see all of them again.
command.isekai_mahou.ui_hud.hints_all: %s hints queued (they show one at a time).
hint.isekai_mahou.label: Tip:
hint.isekai_mahou.level_up: Level up! Open the menu (%s) and check the Status tab to see what changed.
hint.isekai_mahou.circle: New Circle: your spells take more glyphs and the level cap went up.
hint.isekai_mahou.element: Element awakened! Build spells with it in the Grimoire (menu %s).
hint.isekai_mahou.glyph: New glyph! Combine it with yours in the Grimoire (menu %s) to craft a spell.
hint.isekai_mahou.first_kill: Creatures you defeat are recorded in the Bestiary (menu %s).
hint.isekai_mahou.safe_zone: Cities are safe zones. Peace Mode turns on by itself so you don't cast by accident (%s toggles).
hint.isekai_mahou.dimension: Another dimension! The Travel tab of the menu (%s) helps you find the way back.
hint.isekai_mahou.low_mana: Running out of %s? Sneak and stand still for 2 seconds to meditate and recover much faster.
hint.isekai_mahou.level_cap: You reached this Circle's level cap. Perform the Ascension to keep leveling.
hint.isekai_mahou.ultimate_ready: Ultimate charged! Hold %s to unleash it.
hint.isekai_mahou.exhaustion: Magic Exhaustion: you can't cast or recover energy until the effect wears off.
hint.isekai_mahou.boss_telegraph: Bosses warn before they strike: step out of the marks that appear on the ground.
hint.isekai_mahou.settings: Want to change the HUD, hints or screen shake? Esc → Options → Isekai Mahou.
tip.isekai_mahou.label: Tip:
tip.isekai_mahou.0: Press B to open the menu: Status, Grimoire, Journal, Travel and much more.
tip.isekai_mahou.1: Spells are made of glyphs: a Form (how it comes out) plus Effects (what it does).
tip.isekai_mahou.2: Sneak and stand still for 2 seconds to meditate and recover energy much faster.
tip.isekai_mahou.3: You have 9 spell loadouts. Hold Alt (or Mouse 5) and scroll to switch.
tip.isekai_mahou.4: Each new Circle lets your spells take more glyphs.
tip.isekai_mahou.5: Reached your Circle's level cap? Perform the Ascension to keep growing.
tip.isekai_mahou.6: Look at a creature to see its health, armor and weaknesses: that's the Analytic Eye.
tip.isekai_mahou.7: Elements react with each other. Try different spells on the same target.
tip.isekai_mahou.8: Cities are safe zones: monsters don't spawn inside.
tip.isekai_mahou.9: Peace Mode (N key) keeps you from casting by accident in town.
tip.isekai_mahou.10: Bosses mark the ground where the blow will land. Get out of the mark!
tip.isekai_mahou.11: Ultimates sit in the G slot, from Circle 4 on, and need charge.
tip.isekai_mahou.13: Map teleport doesn't work: travel through Teleport Stones and discovered places.
tip.isekai_mahou.14: The J key shows or hides the objective tracker.
tip.isekai_mahou.15: New glyphs are earned: exploration, bosses and temples.
tip.isekai_mahou.16: In your city, more builders mean more construction sites at once.
tip.isekai_mahou.17: Your city has needs: food, fuel, safety and morale. Keep an eye on the panel.
tip.isekai_mahou.18: There are 15 classes, each with its own route, items and secrets.
tip.isekai_mahou.19: Missed a notice? They are kept in the Notices tab of the menu (B).
tip.isekai_mahou.20: You can resize the HUD and turn parts of it off in Options → Isekai Mahou.
tip.isekai_mahou.21: Weak PC? Options → Isekai Mahou → Performance has ready-made modes for your machine.
tip.isekai_mahou.22: At Death's Door, get back to your body before the Reapers catch you.
tip.isekai_mahou.23: When you play in a party, bosses get stronger.
tip.isekai_mahou.24: The Guild gives quests and ranks. Look for the quest board.
tip.isekai_mahou.25: The Bestiary, in the menu (B), keeps the creatures you have faced.
tip.isekai_mahou.26: Your actions change your reputation with factions. The Wanted are not welcome.
tip.isekai_mahou.27: Strong spells have a cast time: the bar below the crosshair shows when they go off.
tip.isekai_mahou.28: Can't cast? Check your energy: the cost shows on each slot.
tip.isekai_mahou.29: Leveling is hard on purpose. The most absurd spells are waiting for you at level 100.
